page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.xlarge is a compute-focused instance type within the Enhanced family, powered by the KVM hypervisor. The instance provides 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 2 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Hardware features include AVX-512 extensions (avx512f and avx512_vnni), hardware cryptography support (AES-NI, VAES, SHA-NI), and cache allocations of 48 KB L1d, 1 MB L2, and 48 MB L3. Memory capacity is configured at 8.0 GB, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 2.0 GB per core. The server does not bundle local storage or dedicated graphics processing units, relying entirely on remote network storage, and provides a baseline network throughput of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark data demonstrates typical performance characteristics for a dual-core, four-thread server configuration. Single-core evaluations, including Geekbench (1554.0) and stress-ng (1841.49), register in the average range, supported by balanced instruction execution in cryptographic operations (PassMark encryption test score of 3540.91) and compression tasks (gzip throughput of 27.89 GB/sec). In contrast, multithreaded capacity scores in the lower brackets, with a PassMark CPU score of 5840.83, a Geekbench multi-core score of 3302.0, and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 20.78 GB/sec. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reaches 30.43 GB/sec and write bandwidth is 25.42 GB/sec.

From an architectural standpoint, the instance balances single-threaded performance against an entry-level core count, trading high parallel throughput for cost efficiency in moderate compute environments. Because local storage is absent, database workloads such as Redis (which recorded 3.85 million SET operations per second) and general database operations are constrained by network storage attachment overhead. The ecs.c7nex.xlarge is well-matched for static web serving (tested at 6.35 GB/sec throughput), proxy servers, lightweight microservices, and continuous integration agents that do not require dense memory arrays or heavy concurrent core utilization.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.xlarge is a compute-oriented virtual server configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 8.0 GB of RAM, allocating 2.0 GB per core, and includes 5 Gbps baseline networking without integrated GPUs or local NVMe storage. Benchmark metrics show average single-threaded efficiency, scoring 1554.0 in Geekbench single-core tests and delivering 27.89 GB/sec in gzip compression, alongside stable cryptographic execution. Multi-threaded metrics reflect the limited physical core count, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 3302.0 and lower comparative results in compilation and parallel decompression. The instance offers resource-effective compute capacity for front-end web serving, microservices, light batch processing, and proxy tasks that operate within moderate thread and memory envelopes.
